synonyms: Can Unpopular Magical Girls Also Date?
synopsis: Chae-Na, who plays the unpopular Clover in [Magical Lucky Stars], the group that protects Madeleine Village. She feels weak and inadequate as a hero, so she lives inconspicuously and endures being an unpopular member. She feels uncomfortable and awkward being in the spotlight. However, there is someone who falls in love with her at first sight after seeing her kindness! It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan. "I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!" She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is... After hearing the heart-fluttering words that she doesn't know anything about you and wants to get to know you more, she eventually runs away. "There's no way such a cool person would like someone like me. There must be some kind of mistake!" A heart-fluttering story of a super popular hero and an unpopular magical girl who accepts his confession. (Source: Peanutoon, translated)

titleRomaji: Taika no Risei
titleNative: タイカの理性
synopsis: Due to a declining birth rate, pets are being transformed into humanoid members of society. But are they truly human? Or are humans truly animals? When misanthrope Ao discovers her family dog, pit bull Taika, standing over the mauled body of her father, she must decide whether to forgive or forget. Ao isn't ready to lose both her beloved father and her devoted pet, so when her mother has Taika humanized, Ao embraces the new dogman and even brings him to school with her. There, Taika meets a German shepherd, an elite police dogman, and begins to unlearn canine behaviors and replace them with human customs. Now, the two dogmen compete to see who will be the first to track down the source of the mysterious traces of blood in Ao's locker… (Source: VIZ Media)

Becoming tired of it all, he decides to commit suicide, but instead he is transported to another world along with all his classmates. When they arrive, they find that they now possess amazing abilities but he was only granted the status of a "healer," the weakest skill of all. The king decides to get rid of him by transporting him to another far away place, but not before Hidako swears revenge against the king, the kingdom, and all of his classmates.

synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand.
